description: Aarhus Municipality publishes its 3D city model through Open Data DK, with the large files hosted on the municipality's own file sharing service. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 describes a volume model built from GeoDanmark 2016 data and last updated from GeoDanmark 2021 data, cut into 1 by 1 kilometre tiles of the Danish grid with heights in DVR90 and offered as DWG in UTM32, DWG in local coordinates and SketchUp files, and a mesh model produced from the Danish Climate Data Agency's 2023 oblique aerial photos in 5 by 5 kilometre tiles; keywords cover buildings, bridges, terrain, forest and trees. Tiles inside the ring road can be downloaded directly, while tiles outside it are supplied on request. A file of the first 3D model buildings of 2006 is listed under CC0. Coverage is the whole municipality of Aarhus. Access is free; licence terms for the main downloads are not stated. Caveats: the files are large CAD and mesh formats that need conversion for GIS use. It supports digital twin, flood and heat studies, such as modelling building exposure to cloudburst flooding. Related record: GNSS Danmark reference station data, including the Aarhus TAPAS station.
